---
title: "2 · The Recipe of Deep Learning"
code-tools: false
toc: false
---

A neural network as a non-linear function with trainable parameters: neurons, layers and activations, the universal approximation theorem, loss functions, gradient descent, backpropagation and automatic differentiation. The first full example is MNIST: a single output trained with the mean squared error against ten outputs trained with the categorical cross-entropy, compared through their confusion matrices.
